name: (🌲) untitled gubby game
desc:
everyone love gubby... we love gubby.. become a gubby. 🐇
untitled gubby game is a game where you can become a bunny named gubby, but that's not all... create stories with your favorite characters, dance famous trends, explore the map, and more...

- 🔥 there are currently 250+ skins, 100+ emotes... and more!
- 👆 drag & drop gubbies anywhere with your mouse or finger... you can turn this off in settings!

- ❤️ like and favorite the game to support us!
- 🎁 join our group to get 30+ cat skins and a badge!

- 🛠️ game is in active development, bugs may occur... we are actively working to fix them!

players engaging in inappropriate activity are actively moderated, report them to us through the support server.

scripts.title: free gamepasses morph (probably outdated)
scripts.features:
gives you gamepasses or exclusive gubby morphs, that's it, I guess.

you can flex on people or something but they probably wouldn't care.
scripts.script:
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local data = player:WaitForChild("PlayerData")
local gamepasses = data:WaitForChild("Gamepasses")
local passes = {
	"America_Flag",
	"BigGubbies",
	"Boombox",
	"Donate",
	"HallowSkins",
	"IceBaton",
	"Independents",
	"PumpkinGrenade",
	"Push",
	"ScaleRemote",
	"Teddy",
	"ValentineSkin26",
	"WinterSkins"
}
for _, name in ipairs(passes) do
	local pass = gamepasses:FindFirstChild(name)
	if pass and pass:IsA("BoolValue") then
		pass.Value = true
	end
end

scripts.title: The Player Grabber 2000
scripts.features:
This script is not mine but I accidentally found abuse in the game when using this script, which allows you to take people like ordinary gubbies and throw them 

HOW ITS WORKS
After you become a flying cube by pressing "Z", you cannot pick up people. However, you cannot do this to old players who were on the server before you. Only players who have just joined can be picked up.

To be able to pick up players who were on the server before you, they need to be killed. The Fling help you with this player collisions are enabled. After that you will be able to pick up that player that's all you need nothing complicated Have fun.



P.S.: You do not become invisible to other players. To them, you appear as a flying ragdoll.
